neet_che_u04_t03_4.working: Free expansion: q, w, ΔU and ΔT all zero (IV). Reversible isothermal: ΔU = 0, q = −w (III). Adiabatic: q = 0, ΔU = w and the gas cools (I). Rigid vessel: w = 0, ΔU = q_V (II).

neet_che_u04_t03_5.working: A is true. B is false: ΔH = q_p, not q_V. C is the intended true statement, since Δn_g = 0 makes ΔH ≈ ΔU. D is false: an ideal gas cools in adiabatic expansion. E is true: q = nRT ln10 = 2 × 8.314 × 300 × 2.303 ≈ 11.5 kJ.
